items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: No, no, no. No, not for a reason. But he was a good trumpet player.

ctx.x: What? In Alexandria? Oh, I've been there too.

In Shreveport, I guess you went up there. Oh, Shreveport, I had a regular job there. With my- That same big Gasper you're talking about there. We had a good band. Glenn and Gasper, we had a band together. Edgar, you know Edgar? Edgar, he's a violin player in New York. Oh, and yeah. Charlie, Charlie- Well, he had a band with me. Glenn and Glenn, we had a band here when you- Is that so? That's why I used to live at Baton Galveston, Sanan. How long ago was that? Oh, it's been quite a while, but- Been quite a while.…
Tell us about the Teo family. Who was the best member of...it was Papa, Teo, Lorenzo? Who were they? Well, I'm going to tell you.
